items.label: GHOULS'N'G. /TWT
items.why: First directory program autostarts into the TWT intro. Space leaves the intro and calls the disk/bootstrap code.

items.label: LOADER
items.why: Six-character filename supplied to SETNAM by the disk wrapper, with bytes loaded at $C000. $C006 dispatches the numbered raw-sector requests.

items.label: {D5}{C0}{C6}{D2}{C6}{C0}{C4}{C5}{C5}{C4}{C0}{C6}{D2}{C6}{C0}{C9}
